summary: Master advanced S&OP process integration and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). Align demand, supply, and finance for strategic growth. Register today.
lede: Sales and operations planning brings demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial priorities into a shared monthly decision cycle. For demand and supply planning managers, analysts, and operations leaders, training develops skills to build a consensus demand review and test capacity-constrained supply scenarios. Participants also practise setting inventory policies, reconciling plans with financial impacts, and presenting exceptions through dashboards and executive decision records.
audienceIntro: Sales and Operations Planning training is designed for experienced professionals who already work with demand, supply, inventory, capacity, or executive planning decisions and need to strengthen an integrated monthly planning cycle.
modules: Supply Review with MRP and DRP
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have practical experience in demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing planning, procurement, sales operations, or supply chain management. Working knowledge of ERP planning data, forecasts, inventory measures, and capacity terminology is expected. No programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted forecasting are addressed at operational application and governance level, not technical engineering level.
